offers_products.reason: Sells an AI-enabled healthcare experience management software platform, which counts as a product.

offers_services.reason: Offers advisory, narrative coaching, analytics consultation and survey programs, and The Governance Institute provides advisory services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are health systems, hospitals and medical groups. Patients are surveyed but do not buy.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to health systems, hospitals, medical groups and not-for-profit hospital boards.

recurring_revenue.reason: Platform subscriptions, ongoing survey programs and Governance Institute memberships give recurring revenue from health systems.

cyclical_demand.reason: Hospitals buy patient experience measurement, often tied to CMS CAHPS reporting and value-based revenue, so demand is fairly stable.

big_ticket.reason: Annual platform subscriptions and survey programs are recurring, moderately sized purchases rather than large one-off sales.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes mainly from its technology platform and data, such as surveys and AI analytics, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are hospitals and health systems such as Nemours Children's Health, which are large healthcare enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Software and survey analytics platform with remote staff; needs no plants or fleets to grow.

notes: Judged on the NRC Health experience management platform; The Governance Institute membership is a smaller part.
